materialization.notes: Materialized 176 variables across two modes (dark, light) via the repo-owned plugin's upsert rail, fetching the artifact over the local token server (pnpm figma:tokens:serve, localhost:4173). Count moved 175 -> 176 in a single additive publish, driven by the accessibility gate rather than by a design change: semantic/color/text/error was core/color/red/500 (#fb2c36), which measures 4.80:1 on background/base but 4.28:1 on background/surface, so error text failed AA on every ground except the base one. Dark now points at a NEW core/color/red/400 (#ff6467) at 5.64:1 on surface and 5.78:1 on the tinted error background; light keeps core/color/red/700 (#c10007) at 6.47:1 and is unchanged. Both moves are additive under CHANGE_POLICY — a new canonical core ID plus a re-valued semantic alias, no rename and no removal, so no runtime-css-aliases entry and no deletion pass was needed. The plugin upserts, so this was a plain re-sync with every existing VariableID preserved. Post-sync verification: Figma's 176 variable names reconcile EXACTLY against the artifact's 176 published leaves, no extras on either side.
